messages:
Maria Chen: FYI Kestrel private/VPC maintenance window set for Thu 2025-06-05 02:00-04:00 UTC. Goal: rollout runtime 1.4.2 + KB cache warmers. Need owners for preflight, canary, smoke, and rollback.

Ajay Patel: I'll lead the rollout and be on-call for the window. Suggest preflight at 01:30 UTC. Who wants canary? :raising_hand:

Liz Mora: I'll take canary and metrics verification. Will monitor request/err rates and tail latency, post snapshots at 01:28 and after canary starts.

Sam O'Neill: Preflight checklist (short):
- validate VPC peering & route tables
- snapshot config to s3://redwood-backups/kestrel/2025-06-05
- quiesce non-critical batch jobs at 01:40
- reduce canary traffic to 2 nodes initially (5rps)
- ensure hot KV prefixes warmed

Sam O'Neill: Preflight smoke commands (run from engctl):
```
# generation smoke - expect latency <400ms
curl -s -X POST "https://internal-api.kestrel.svc/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ENG_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '{latency:.latency_ms, ok:.error_count}'

# kv cache check
ssh jump@kestrel-canary "redis-cli GET kv:prefix:0 || echo \"MISSING\""
```
Abort criteria: error rate >1% or p95 latency >500ms sustained >3m.

Evan Rios: Note: telemetry schema tweak is backwards-compatible; I'll keep an eye. If anything odd shows up, I can flip telemetry flag separate from runtime rollback.

Kai Nguyen: I'll be rollback owner. Rollback plan: if errors >5% or sustained p95 >600ms for 5m, roll back to runtime 1.4.1 and flush new cache shards. Rollback command ready: 
```
engctl rollout set-runtime --env=kestrel --runtime=1.4.1 --reason=\"post-1.4.2 regression\"
```
I'll be standing by and will confirm keys/access before window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: kestrel-maint-2025-06-05-02. Reminder 30m before.

Ajay Patel: Plan timeline: 01:20 UTC - ops handoff with infra on-call; 01:30 - preflight checks; 01:40 - quiesce jobs; 02:00 - rollout start; +10m and +30m smoke checks. @Liz Mora @Kai Nguyen please react or confirm readiness by 01:25.

Liz Mora: Confirmed. Will post dashboard snapshots at 01:28 and another at +10m. Bring runbooks: /docs/runbooks/kestrel-rollout.md

Kai Nguyen: Confirmed. Rollback playbook tested in staging. SSH keys and engctl perms are in place.

Sam O'Neill: I'll do the job quiesce at 01:40 and kick off canary at 02:05 if preflight clean. Will post short pastebin of smoke outputs.

Maria Chen: Thanks — I'll open a post-window notes thread after the window for any follow-ups and perf diffs. Leave any last-minute asks here. :thumbsup:
